name.baseName: Ethanol, 99.7% in H2O, from biomass, at distillation

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Data is from the etha+ project (Alcosuisse, CH) and the ASIATIC project (LASEN, CH), adapted to CN context

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Dehydration is done by molecular sieve technology.

# Included processes
This dataset includes the dehydration of hydrated ethanol (95%) to anhydrous ethanol (99.7%). Hydrated ethanol input is sorghum-based ethanol, produced in the CN context. Treatment of waste streams is included.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data is from the etha+ project (Alcosuisse, CH) and the ASIATIC project (LASEN, CH), technology by French ethanol plant supplier, modelling by ENERS (CH)
